options.onRender: function fb(b){b=b||0;if(b>=1073741824)return (b/1073741824).toFixed(2)+' GiB';if(b>=1048576)return (b/1048576).toFixed(0)+' MiB';return (b/1024).toFixed(0)+' KiB';}var m={},nm={};try{if(data&&data.series){data.series.forEach(function(s){var vf=null,name='';if(s.fields){for(var i=0;i<s.fields.length;i++){var fd=s.fields[i];if(fd.type==='number')vf=fd;if(fd.labels&&fd.labels.name)name=fd.labels.name;}}if(vf){var vs=vf.values;var v=Array.isArray(vs)?vs[vs.length-1]:(vs&&vs.get?vs.get(vs.length-1):0);m[s.refId]=v||0;nm[s.refId]=name;}});}}catch(e){}function set(id,t){var el=htmlNode.querySelector(id);if(el)el.textContent=t;}set('#c-total',Math.round(m.A||0));set('#c-img',Math.round(m.B||0));set('#c-cpuhost',(m.C||0).toFixed(1)+'%');set('#c-ramhost',(m.D||0).toFixed(1)+'%');set('#c-topcpu',(nm.E||'--')+' ('+(m.E||0).toFixed(2)+' cores)');set('#c-topram',(nm.F||'--')+' ('+fb(m.F)+')');
